dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: Some tea leaves taste better when they're newly harvested, and some when they've been sitting in storage for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: Some leaves must be stored for years and re-baked from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: They're difficult to make, and even harder to store. But if those two hurdles are overcome, the flavor is... What's the right word for it... Ah, yes, "peerless"! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Luo
dialogues.text: ...It's a shame that people these days don't want to wait, nor do they want to learn.
